# Crawford Living Realty, LLC

> Crawford Living Realty, LLC is a Florida real estate brokerage serving home buyers and sellers across Central Florida. Its broker and owner is Michael "Mike" Crawford, RENE, CPRES, a Florida real estate broker licensed since 2004.

## Key facts

- Brokerage: Crawford Living Realty, LLC (Florida brokerage license CQ1075533)
- Broker: Michael "Mike" Crawford, RENE, CPRES (Florida broker license BK3074190)
- Licensed in Florida real estate since 2004; his license grew out of years coordinating new-home construction
- Service area: Central Florida, including Orange, Seminole, Osceola, Lake and Volusia counties
- Services: selling a home, buying a home, new construction guidance, and selling a home that is part of an estate (probate)
- Phone: 321-488-5542
- Email: mdc@crawfordliving.com
- Website: https://crawfordliving.com/

## Pages

- [Home](https://crawfordliving.com/): overview of the practice
- [Selling a home](https://crawfordliving.com/sell.html): pricing, marketing and reporting for sellers
- [Buying a home](https://crawfordliving.com/buy.html): timing, contract deadlines and what to watch for as a buyer
- [New construction](https://crawfordliving.com/new-construction.html): why to bring your own broker when buying from a builder
- [When an estate includes a home](https://crawfordliving.com/probate.html): for personal representatives selling a home in probate
- [Inherited a house in Orlando](https://crawfordliving.com/inherited-house-orlando.html): plain-language first steps, who can sign, and probate in Orange, Seminole, Osceola, Lake and Volusia counties
- [Florida Amendment 3 homestead exemption](https://crawfordliving.com/amendment-3-homestead-exemption.html): what the new exemption means for property taxes and how to file
- [Search homes](https://crawfordliving.com/search.html): home search app and curated search request
- [About Mike Crawford](https://crawfordliving.com/about.html): background and credentials
